summary: A thin divider line used to group related links inside the page navigation menu.
description: Correction to the 'no separator implementation' citation: moz-page-nav.mjs does render a real separator, `${when(this.hasSecondaryNav, () => html`<hr />`)}`, placed between the primary-nav-group and secondary-nav-group in its own render() output; it's just a plain <hr> with no dedicated class/tagName, not a distinct sub-component.
